Deploy Bot: [deploybot] Starting regional phased rollout v2.4.2 -> US=20%, EU=0%, APAC=0%. Change window 2024-08-28 23:30-03:30 UTC. Auto-holdpoints at 20% increments.
Nina: US canary live. Watching per-model p95 and the billing route specifically.
Carlos: US warm nodes: 48/60. p50=100ms, p95=210ms. No 5xx.
Tara: EU reserved capacity 28 GPUs, currently at 76% utilization. If ramped to 20% during peak we could reach 88% within 15m. Recommend conservative ramp.
SRE Oncall: Thermal margin 13%. Setting proactive alert at warmpool <74%. Eviction strategy ready.
Deploy Bot: US check: healthy. checks=ok(70/70), errs=0, avgGPU=30%.
Nina: Let's do EU 5% first, hold 10m, evaluate.
Deploy Bot: EU ramp queued to 5%.
Infra-Priv Bot: APAC artifact egress: permission pending. Ticket #INF-499 open.
Carlos: If EU shows stable p95 <2x baseline and no error spike, proceed to 15% after hold.
Tara: Agreed. Also flagging that if warm node loss >=8% in 5m we'll do emergency pin to v2.4.0.
SRE Oncall: Noted. Rollback triggers repl: p95 >2x baseline for >=10m, error rate >1% 5m, GPU OOMs >=2 in 4m, warm node loss >=8% in 5m.
Nina: Runbook commands in case of pin/rollback:
```
redwoodctl pin --region eu --version v2.4.0
redwoodctl throttle --slice eu --percent 5
redwoodctl rollback --release v2.4.2 --reason "eu instability"
```
Tara: Taking EU snapshots and enabling more verbose logs.
Deploy Bot: EU holdpoint reached: 5% stable. ok=15/15, errs=0, p95=235ms.
Carlos: small spike in CPU for one host in EU noisy neighbor, but auto-mitigation started. No customer impact.
SRE Oncall: monitoring host eviction events. none so far.
Infra-Priv Bot: INF-499: APAC egress approved for infra service account. APAC canary go-ahead.
Nina: Spinning up APAC +6 GPUs transient for canary.
Deploy Bot: APAC canary started -> target 5%. health=ok(12/12), errs=0, avgCPU=35%.
Tara: Holdpoint for 12m across regions. We'll reconvene after hold to decide 30% wave.
Nina: I'll post results in #release-updates after hold. Call out if anyone needs a manual pin.
SRE Oncall: standing by.
Carlos: good run so far, thanks team.
Deploy Bot: Holdpoint reached. US/EU/APAC at 20/5/5. Next ramp pending manual ack.
